ARU’s Business School stands out because the courses focus on the real world of business. Many of the courses combine sound academic theory with solid management practice. ARU College’s Pre-Masters pathway (Cambridge) leads onto a number of business, finance and management Masters courses at ARU, which are taught at either our Cambridge or Chelmsford campus.

The MBA Banking and Finance program gives students both theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience in international finance and investment. Students will spend time analysing numbers as well as business plans, autonomously and as part of an organisation’s senior leadership team – all the while enhancing their employability.

As a postgraduate student at ARU, students will experience an exciting mix of business strategy alongside in-depth finance modules. Students will be able to enhance their existing skills and ignite their career – whichever direction they wish to take it in.

A postgraduate pathway is a single course comprising two stages of study; Pre-Master’s and Master’s. When students successfully complete the full pathway they will be awarded a Master’s degree from ARU. The Pre-Master’s pathway will prepare learners for future postgraduate studies by giving them confidence and expertise in areas relevant to their taught Master’s degree.

The Pre-Master’s course is Stage 1 of the postgraduate pathway, and is one semester in duration. It has been designed to prepare students who have not qualified for direct entry to ARU’s Master’s degrees, for postgraduate level studies. Undertaking a Pre-Master’s course will provide students with the time to adjust to the rigorous research and independent study requirements of postgraduate studies and prepare them to get the most out of their postgraduate study at ARU. The Master’s (Stage 2) offers students the chance to build on what they have learned during the Pre-Master’s and extend their professional understanding about their relevant area of study.

ARU’s Business School stands out because the courses focus on the real world of business. Many of the courses combine sound academic theory with solid management practice. At ARU College, students develop industry-level skills needed to thrive in a modern global environment. They learn to be adaptable and agile across all areas of business management and economic sectors. Students have the opportunity to get involved with a wide range of student initiatives like ARU’s Big Pitch entrepreneurship competition to inspire their ideas and support them towards making their mark.
